content.comment_body: Hello [product_expert], is it possible to control a [company_name] drive using [product_name] [version_no] over TCP/IP? I am interested in receiving frequency and analog values on the [product_name], sending setpoints to the PID of the drive, and managing start/stop operations remotely.
Hello [user_name], please post in English within the message body, not just in the title.
Do you have documentation for the Modbus registers of this converter or TCP/IP communication module?
You might want to check chapter 5 of that reference book.
I was unable to find any register addresses mentioned in chapter 5.
Hello [user_name], based on what I know, these devices typically only support Modbus RTU. Could you specify the exact model of the drive? Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is looking to interface a [company_name] drive with [product_name] [version_no] using TCP/IP for exchanging process data. The discussion reveals uncertainty about device compatibility and whether TCP/IP or only Modbus RTU is supported, and requests for specific technical details and official documentation. There is a clear need for clarification on connectivity and supported communication protocols.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to use TCP/IP to transfer setpoints, status, and analog values between [product_name] [version_no] and the [company_name] drive, aiming to enable remote PID control and start/stop capabilities.
